findings.description: Initial fixture queued TP but only drained callback events; corrected to run actual queued exit work.
Copied example fixture path and missing execution-section key accesses must resolve actual baseline config values, not fail via missing files/keys.
B slow-query test must maintain fresh quotes while advancing clock so it isolates first T0 and includes query elapsed without conflicting with the new 3-second quote gate.
Restart regression must require healthy startup, not catch every StartupError and pass merely because no TP is sent.
Safety tests must include possible local UNKNOWN/CANCEL_SEEN capacity and checks before/after actual broker writes, beyond Fake exchange terminal truth.
Price rejection tests require exact labels and known IDs, durable ACK deduplication/failed-part retries, and independent events remain visible.
